brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1792x1024 or preferably 1920x1080 PNG (at least 1000 pixels wide). This is a newly drawn image, not a photo or photo collage.
Match the approved black-and-lime ink/brushed illustration style already viewed in this conversation: near-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brush strokes, off-white heavy Japanese gothic lettering, restrained orange basketball. Sparse, powerful editorial composition, premium sports magazine feel. Do not reuse any player, statistic, name, score or date from the style sample.

The only human is real professional basketball player Avi Koki Schafer (シェーファー アヴィ幸樹), selected because he is the most extensively discussed individual in the supplied article. The JOC official headshot was visually inspected: dark brown almost black, medium-short thick hair naturally center-parted with rounded curtain-like sides; elongated oval/angular face and narrow chin; thick fairly straight eyebrows, almond hazel-brown eyes, long straight prominent nose, slightly long neck, clean shaven with only extremely faint chin stubble. Reproduce these individual facial characteristics faithfully in expressive hand-drawn black/ivory ink illustration. No generic substitute athlete. Athletic tall broad-shouldered physique. Keep face recognizable and sufficiently large. Do not paste or imitate a photographic texture.

Composition: Subject on the RIGHT 43 percent, waist/thigh-up dynamic three-quarter view. A vigorous basketball rebound/possession illustration: elbows flexed, both hands naturally gripping one orange ball near upper chest/shoulder, torso twisting and gaze alert to his left. No opponent, no extra people, no extra limbs. Both hands visibly anatomically natural with correct finger structure. The ball is only a prop held by this real athlete. Plain ivory basketball jersey with black folds and subtle lime accents, no numbers, no lettering, no team or league or sponsor logos. Energy supplied by a broad lime dry-brush sweep behind him; no specific arena or identifiable match moment. Head, face, ball and hands entirely inside canvas. Torso may naturally continue at bottom/right edge.

LEFT 55 percent is a clear text area, generously spaced, no overlap with face or ball. Set the following exact text ONLY, with normal readable Japanese glyphs. Main headline extremely bold, off-white first line and lime second line; supporting copy smaller but crisp. Clear hierarchy; keep all typography 5 percent inside the edges.
Top small heading: 「B.PREMIER 順位表」
Main headline two lines:
「東西の」
「上位争い」
Below, an ivory or lime accent rule and medium line: 「12/4 再開」
Below that, smaller qualifier: 「11/23時点｜独自分析」
Bottom left mandatory readable footer: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」
Do not draw the quotation marks themselves. Do not add any other text, individual player name or player statistics.

Editorial grounding: source.html and source.txt fixed manuscript ONLY say the league is paused, resumes December 4, and this article analyzes east/west upper-table competition using standings as of November 23. This image conveys that general topic. Do NOT claim the pictured player performed this action in an actual game. The footer explicitly labels an illustrative AI image. Do not invent results, a match score, an actual decisive play, representation selection certainty, or fatigue effects. No official photos, logos, watermark, photorealism, scoreboards, small data tables or extra visual clutter.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION PROMPT:
Edit this single existing thumbnail with ONE layout correction only. Keep the 1672x941 landscape 16:9 canvas (or same aspect at larger resolution). Preserve EVERY text glyph verbatim, its placement, colors, typography and legibility, as well as the black #151A18 / lime #CCF43B dry-brush sports illustration style and all background design.
Keep the same real athlete Avi Koki Schafer, the same recognizable elongated oval face, center-parted dark hair, clean-shaven features, pose, both anatomically correct hands and one ball. Do not redraw or change his identity or add any elements. Uniform stays completely plain, no numbers or logos.
ONLY scale the athlete-and-ball illustration group to about 88 percent of its current size, anchoring the bottom and moving it slightly left as needed. The ENTIRE hair silhouette needs at least 45 pixels clear dark margin from the TOP edge, and the entire right hand and ball must have at least 45 pixels margin from the RIGHT edge. The player's lower torso can naturally continue through the bottom edge. Keep the player illustration to the right of the headline with no text overlap. Preserve ball and both hands fully inside canvas.
All text must stay exactly:
B.PREMIER 順位表
東西の
上位争い
12/4 再開
11/23時点｜独自分析
イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ
No additional text or people. No photo appearance, team/league/sponsor logos, or claimed actual match scene.
